title: Drawing document, Drawing Format Standard 1.0
description: Structure of a drawing document. Model coordinates are metres (+y up). Paper values are millimetres. The unit of every number is the end of its member name: _m, _mm or _deg. See docs/standard/drawing-format-standard.md. Rules that a schema cannot state are listed in clause 18.5.

standard_version.description: The version of the standard that the document follows, as MAJOR.MINOR. A reader checks that it can read this version (clause 18.2).

sheet.description: Size, orientation and line group of the sheet.

line_group.description: Must equal the group of the sheet size (clause 8.2.2).

layers.description: The layers in use. A standard layer is declared by name. A custom layer also gives role, line type and CAD colour.

point_m.description: A point in model space: x then y, in metres.

frame.description: The frame on paper, in millimetres. x_mm and y_mm are the top-left corner.

scale.description: The denominator N of the ratio 1:N (an ISO preferred ratio or a house ratio), or the word fit.

scale_bar.description: An optional derived scale bar. An empty object asks for the derived length.

text.description: One line, in the character set of clause 11.6.2.

point_spec.description: A model point: either a reference to a place of an entity of the same viewport, or a point in metres.

text.description: One line, in the character set of clause 11.6.2.

symbol.description: A symbol of a library (clause 13.2). Lengths have the unit named by units, and no unit ending (clause 13.2.1).

label.description: One line, in the character set of clause 11.6.2.
